# Coriolis, LLC

Coriolis builds websites gun stores own and sells anonymized category search to brands. Greenville, SC.

Facts: 100+ clients. 5-star Google rating from 17 reviews. Phone (279) 258-6771. Greenville, SC; we serve FFL dealers across the US as a service-area business (no street address).

## Products and prices
- FFL Accelerator: $569 a month. WooCommerce on the dealer domain. Setup $500 or $2,500. No year lock. They leave with the site.
- Gun Search Engine: free on a dealer site. Included with FFL Accelerator.
- Demand Intelligence: brands. Full-market anonymized search. Seats $49 per user per month. One Client Admin free.
- Grok Bot setup: $995. One session. Their Cursor seat. We never rent them ours.
- Gun Store Game: consumer game. Dealer claim is a separate door.

## Our sites
- coriolisagency.com: the company, the hosting plans, and the comparison pages. You are here.
- fflaccelerator.com: the FFL Accelerator offer. Our ads only point there.
- gunsearchengine.com: gun search for shoppers, and the dealer tools.

GunSearchAgent is retired. FFLIntel is our journal on gun demand numbers (fflintel.com). FFLAnalytics and FFL Search Console are names we hold; FFL Search Console is a free feature of a GunSearchEngine dealer account.

We do not file a 4473, run NICS, write a bound book, or run the register. We are not affiliated with Gearfire or RetailBI.
